**Finding: deviation (high severity) — licence grant scope**

The Section 2(a) grant runs to Client only, and Section 8(c) reinforces this by limiting access to Client's own officers, employees and agents — so affiliates and contractors acting for us are excluded with no mechanism to add them. Two related gaps: Section 13(b) terminates the licence "promptly upon ... any violations or breach" of Sections 8a–8c with no materiality threshold or cure period (effectively vendor-side revocation), and Section 15 permits affiliate assignment but not transfer to a successor in an M&A transaction.

Validated redline (preferred position, ok:true):
- **p0022** — grant extended to "Client, its affiliates and its contractors acting on Client's behalf".
- **p0053** — access restriction conformed to officers, employees, contractors and agents of Client and its affiliates.
- **p0078** — licence termination limited to material breach uncured within 30 days' written notice.
- **p0080** — successor-transfer carve-out added for merger, acquisition, reorganization or sale of substantially all assets.

Fallback noted in the comment: affiliate coverage on written notice plus M&A successor transfer, if TrueLink resists the broader contractor language.
